newsitem.title: USA: OMNI Multimedia sees Q3 net loss $3.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: OMNI Multimedia sees Q3 net loss $3.5 mln.

text.p: OMNI Multimedia Group Inc said Tuesday it has increased the estimated net loss in its third quarter to $3.5 million from $2.5 million.
The projected increase in the net loss was contained in papers it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission seeking an extension for that period's earnings.
The company said the increase in the projected loss is primarily due to expenses associated with the restructuring of its preferred stock and its acquisition of Allenbach Industries Inc.
OMNI chief financial officer Robert Lee said in a statement that the company "anticipates operating results to improve significantly commencing with the current quarter."
In the prior year's third quarter, ended December 30, 1995, the company reported net income of about $400,000. This year's third quarter ended December 28.
